name: obsidian-find-in-note
description: Search the current Obsidian note and highlight every match in place, without unrendering tables or callouts.

scripts.build: npm run lint && tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && npm run check && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

author: mikagosz
